title: Wellness Membership Enrollment Fee and Its Waivers
content:
The Wellness Membership enrollment fee is a one-time charge of the member's tier, and two waivers stand against it.

## Clauses

**1. The fee.** The enrollment fee of the member's tier is billed at sign-up unless one of two waivers applies.

**2. Discharge waiver.** A patient discharged from an Insured Plan of Care or a Workers' Compensation Referral, or whose Self-Pay Visit Package was exhausted, is waived only when signing up no later than 30 calendar days after the discharge date on file. The window is 30 calendar days on every tier.

**3. Counting the discharge window.** Days are counted as calendar days from the discharge date, the discharge date itself being day zero. A sign-up on day 30 is within the window; a sign-up on day 31 is not.

**4. Rejoin waiver.** A former member rejoining no later than 90 calendar days after the cancellation date is waived. The window is 90 calendar days on every tier.

**5. Everyone else.** Anyone to whom neither waiver applies pays the enrollment fee of the tier.

## The record the discharge waiver rests on

- The discharge date on file is the date the company's records hold: the discharge date recorded on the patient's Insured Plan of Care or Workers' Compensation Referral, or, for an exhausted Self-Pay Visit Package, the date on which that package closed. A patient's own recollection of the date does not stand in for it.
- The record must belong to the same patient who is signing up for the Wellness Membership.
- The window is judged before the membership is opened, on the sign-up date against that record.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates)

| Discharge date on file | Sign-up date | Day count | Discharge waiver |
|---|---|---|---|
| June 1 | June 1 | day 0 | applies |
| June 1 | July 1 | day 30 | applies |
| June 1 | July 2 | day 31 | does not apply |

| Cancellation date of the former membership | Rejoin date | Calendar days after the cancellation date | Rejoin waiver |
|---|---|---|---|
| March 1 | May 30 | 90 | applies |
| March 1 | May 31 | 91 | does not apply |

## Combinations

| Discharge waiver applies | Rejoin waiver applies | Enrollment fee |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | No | waived |
| No | Yes | waived |
| Yes | Yes | waived |
| No | No | billed at the tier's figure |
